subject.title: fix(tui): keep assistant text chronological across tool calls and resume; condense tool cards

question: Should the TUI adopt this three-tier verbosity contract: off shows aggregate activity, on shows compact per-tool cards, and full includes tool output previews?
rationale: The implementation is technically coherent, but it deliberately changes established user-visible verbosity semantics rather than only repairing chronological ordering.

options.title: Adopt the three-tier hierarchy
options.body: Rebase and re-prove the branch, then land the compact off/on/full presentation with the chronology fix.

options.title: Narrow to ordering only
options.body: Keep existing verbosity presentation and split compact cards, activity summaries, and full-tier exposure into separately sponsored work.

options.title: Preserve the current UI
options.body: Decline the presentation changes and close the PR after extracting any independently desired chronology regression coverage.

recommendation.title: Adopt the three-tier hierarchy
recommendation.body: Rebase and re-prove the branch, then land the compact off/on/full presentation with the chronology fix.

likelyOwner.reason: The history connects this person to the original TUI surface and repeated streaming/session behavior decisions.
